_comment: #784 lexical-sensitive RAG fixtures. Exact-code / rare-identifier queries that dense embeddings under-retrieve but Postgres FTS (LexicalDocumentRetriever) recalls. Kept in a SEPARATE suite ('rag-lexical') from 'rag-retrieval' so they do NOT count toward the #783 dense recall@k gate; they are scored dense-vs-hybrid once eval_live.py grows a hybrid-scoring pass. Queries use tokens verbatim from rag/glossary-identifiers.md and rag/role-permission-matrix.md.

fixtures.notes: Human-facing workorder number WO-YYYY-NNNN. Dense under-retrieves codes; FTS should recall glossary.identifiers.

fixtures.query: EST-YYYY-NNNN estimate number unique per location
fixtures.notes: Estimate number format EST-YYYY-NNNN, a verbatim token in the glossary.
Exact DB constraint name uk_product_sku; a rare token dense retrieval misses.
VIN regex + vin_normalized column; symbol-heavy exact tokens embeddings blur.
Goods-receipt prefix GR-<uuid8>; short code, poor dense signal.
Runtime invoice number format INV-<epochMillis>-<uuid8>; verbatim in the glossary.
Colon-delimited permission codes are exact tokens; caller holds the scope perms, so hybrid should recall security.role-permission-matrix.
